invariants: whole-highlighter and file-scoped refreshes contribute independent epochs
unknown highlighter ids warn without changing an epoch
stale file ids racing a reload are silent no-ops
qualified ids may invalidate a highlighter registered by another extension
reload reconciliation removes epochs for retired file ids and registrations
unchanged registrations retain surviving epochs across runtime replacement

nativeAdaptation.controls: A validated RefreshLineHighlights JSON-RPC host action replaces a frozen JavaScript callback object.
nativeAdaptation.ownership: The subprocess host checks the line-highlighter capability; the Ratatui host owns registry lookup, warnings, and epochs.
nativeAdaptation.coverage: Four controller tests translate the four upstream tests; API and TUI tests execute wire and dispatch integration.
